Addition to this card's "not in scope" stale-prose list, from the L1 of PR #37204 (7154277408, nit N1): `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json:35` still names the product mark 「PRODUCT home (e.g. ObjectOS home)」 with no width qualifier. From 768 px up, the mark's accessible name is 「Back to app start page」. #37166 also rewrites that file, so whichever of #37166 and this card touches it last should add the width qualifier.
